outcome: maternal death due to severe preeclampsia (SPE)
cohort: Pregnant women with blood pressure ≥ 160/120 mmHg and proteinuria ≥ 3+ whose medical records were collected from three referral hospitals in Souss Massa, southern Morocco.
finding: Absence of fetal heartbeat, fetal bradycardia, altered consciousness, maternal age (<25 and ≥35 years), rural residence, severe anaemia, and preexisting diabetes mellitus were identified as potential factors associated with maternal death due to severe preeclampsia.
